This is a **finding** in the frozen driver ([dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py)).

### Cause
1. In [`parse_providers`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L107-L115), provider matching checks only whether a provider's last name appears as a substring in `u.lower()`, ignoring negation. For `"Dr. Okafor, not Dr. Chen"`, both `Dr. Chen` (`PR1`) and `Dr. Okafor` (`PR3`) match, so `parse_providers` returns both IDs.
2. In [`Driver.book`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L398-L414), when `len(cand) > 1`, it unconditionally stores `prov_options` and re-asks `"We have Dr. Chen and Dr. Okafor for dermatology. Which would you like?"` without ever falling back to `self.m.ask("provider", ...)` or calling `self.unclear("provider", ...)`. Because `self.unclear` is never reached, `unclear_counts` never increments and the patient is never handed off to staff.
